chunks: Yet he wants that I should give him more.

key_terms.يَطْمَعُ: He desires greedily / He hopes for more

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the greedy person who withholds wealth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase highlights the psychological contradiction of the stingy man (al-Abtal) who clings to wealth not for necessity but for the sake of accumulation itself, reflecting a spiritual poverty despite material abundance. This greed is often linked to the fear of losing status or security, illustrating how miserliness stems from a lack of trust in divine provision (tawakkul). The verse thus serves as a moral critique of hoarding, contrasting it with the generosity expected of the faithful.
